requests.reply: {"translations": ["Start with Memote", "Memote is a note app that can consolidate text, tables, and images into one place.", "This guide will explain using the examples of Public Relations' Yumeguri (Yamanashi) and Sales' Kotohiyayu (Takanashi)."]}
